sourceRequirements.summary:
JNEB publishes nutrition-education and behaviour research; the structured abstract ends with Conclusions and Implications.

Distilled requirements: Body up to 4,500 words; abstract up to 250 words; required sections: Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion; AMA citation style.

Also required: Structured abstract (Objective/Design/Participants/Main Outcome Measures/Analysis/Results/Conclusions and Implications).

This summary is the app's distillation — open the author instructions above to confirm against the journal's current text.
